# Fixture provenance

All files in this directory are captured-sanitized from the TASK-001 live
qualification probes (2026-09-22, macOS arm64, codex-cli 0.155.1). Emails,
accountId, and rate-limit reset credit ids were replaced with deterministic
placeholders per docs/verification/compatibility.md; percentages, durations,
timestamps, null placement, and field ordering are the live values. Synthetic
edge-case fixtures added by later tasks are tagged in the owning task evidence.
